name: Announcer
description: Show a themed message when a player enters or leaves a chosen Trigger Area, or receive announcements from Game Flow.

changelog.notes: Announcements show at the top centre with the other notices instead of near the bottom, where phones draw their touch controls.
Initial release: server code anywhere in the scene calls game.broadcast('announce', { text }) and every player's client shows the line for a few seconds.
The placed item's Script card now shows the broadcast line that makes it speak, under its hold seconds and font size.
Shared theme and a Trigger Area picker for local messages without writing code.
